stages.text: Walk a lap of the Approach Concourse - WASD or the arrow keys.

one_way_message.text: You're on the induction - it tracks in your Mission Log (N). Feet first: walk the length of the concourse on WASD or the arrow keys.

stages.text: Target someone - press [ or ] to cycle a lock, or click them.

one_way_message.text: See everyone on the ring? Tap [ or ] to cycle a target lock, or just click a person. Their name and role show top-right.

stages.text: Walk up to someone and talk - press T.

one_way_message.text: Get in close to anyone and press T. Shopkeepers open their store; everyone else has something to say - and most of it's worth hearing right now.

stages.text: Open your Mission Log - press N.

one_way_message.text: Press N for your Mission Log. Every step I give you is listed there.

stages.text: Open your Possessions - press P (check the Standing panel).

one_way_message.text: Press P for Possessions - credits, ships, cargo, and your Standing with each faction. Right now you're Friendly with the Authority and neutral everywhere else. That will change.

stages.text: Take the Authority starter loan - Signal Officer Doss, Lender's Office (south-west).

one_way_message.text: South-west bay, the Lender's Office. Talk to Signal Officer Doss and take the starter loan - you'll need it for a hull.

stages.text: Buy a ship - Harbor-Master Crane, the Berth (north-east).

one_way_message.text: Now the Berth, north-east. Harbor-Master Crane has hulls for sale - the courier's an easy first ship. Buy whichever you like.

stages.text: Board your ship - step on the Berth portal and press L.

one_way_message.text: That's the ring done. Your ship's docked at the Berth - step on the portal and press L to board. I'll raise you once you're in the cockpit.

stages.text: Turn both ways - left (A / Left), then right (D / Right).

one_way_message.text: Hub Control, reading you in the cockpit. Start simple - turn left with A, then right with D. Give me both.

stages.text: Thrust forward - W or Up. Watch your speed build.

one_way_message.text: Good. Hold W to thrust. Space doesn't slow you down on its own - remember that.

stages.text: Turn around and brake until your speed drops - S, then thrust.

one_way_message.text: Now cancel it - hold S to point retrograde, then thrust to kill your speed.

stages.text: Fly clear of the system centre, then jump to Kiln (M to pick it, J to jump).

one_way_message.text: Last thing. Kiln's beacon is keyed - fly well clear of the star until the drift prompt shows, open the Star Map (M), select Kiln, and press J. Log what you find there, pilot. Halcyon out.
